# dreamrouter_ports (Data Source)

Lists the router's own ports and their roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_ports" "all" {}

output "ports" {
  value = { for p in data.dreamrouter_ports.all.ports : p.name => "${p.interface} ${p.role}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ports` (Attributes List) The ports, in the web UI's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `index` (Number) Number in the web UI (1 = Port 1).
- `interface` (String) e.g. "eth2".
- `media` (String) e.g. "2.5GE", "SFP+".
- `name` (String) e.g. "Port 3", "SFP+ 1".
- `role` (String) "LAN", "WAN" (Internet 1) or "WAN2" (Internet 2).
- `speed_mbps` (Number) Link speed; 0 if down.
- `up` (Boolean) Whether a cable (or module) has a link.
